newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesian rupiah soften ahead of holiday.
newsitem.headline: Indonesian rupiah soften ahead of holiday.

text.p: The Indonesian rupiah softened against the dollar in moderate early trading on Wednesday.
Dealers said operators moved to cover positions and some went long on dollars because of a public holiday on Thursday in Indonesia, driving the dollar up despite a tight rupiah market.

"But I think the dollar appears to be toppish at the 2,429.0 level for now," one U.S. bank dealer said, adding that the rate was likely to range between 2,427 and 2,429 for the rest of the day. She said operators increased buying pressure after realising strong dollar support despite an expensive overnight rate in the money market.
Dealers said there was no immediate response seen in the foreign exchange market after Indonesia reported a slight increase in April inflation and a healthy February trade surplus.
They said the focus remained on liquidity and the on-going campaign for general elections on May 29.
"There is not much going on. People are just covering for the holiday and the weekend," the U.S. bank dealer said, adding that offshore players were still long in swaps.
Spot rupiah, due May 12, was at 2,428.00/28.75 at 0330 GMT against an opening of 2,425.5/26.5.
Tomorrow and today rupiah were at 2,426.50/27.25 and 2,425.50/26.25, respectively.
Another foreign bank dealer said swaps trended to the right in a tightening money market, but they eased along with the softening overnight rate to 14.0/14.5 percent.
Overnight swap was at 1.10/1.25 and tom/next at 1.50/1.55.
One-month swaps were at 13.25/13.75, two at 26.00/27.00, three at 38.0/39.0 and six at 76.5/77.5 points.
Bank Indonesia raised its intervention band by one point to 2,408/2,600 and the conversion band to 2,408/2,456 on Tuesday. -- Jakarta newsroom +6221 384-6364
